_comment: Example payload generated by site_audit.py. Field keys must match custom fields created in your GoHighLevel sub-account. Not tested against a live GHL account.

customFields.top_issue_1: Problem: Page allows search engines to list it. Fix: Remove 'noindex' (often left over from a staging site) unless this page should stay hidden.
customFields.top_issue_2: Problem: Page is set up for mobile phones. Fix: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the page head.
customFields.top_issue_3: Problem: Business address search engines can read. Fix: Show your address or service area on the page and add it to LocalBusiness schema.
